entries.text: May I take leave on Friday, please?
entries.easy_read:
I want a day off.
I ask for Friday.

entries.text: I have a medical appointment on Tuesday morning.
entries.easy_read:
I must see the doctor.
It is Tuesday morning.

entries.text: I wanted to tell you early so you can plan the shift.
entries.easy_read:
I tell you now, not later.
Then you can plan the work.

entries.text: I am unwell today and cannot come to work.
entries.easy_read:
I am not well.
I cannot work today.

entries.text: I am sorry, I will be about twenty minutes late.
entries.easy_read:
I will come late today.
I say sorry.

entries.text: Could I leave two hours early today?
entries.easy_read:
I want to go home early.
I ask my boss first.

entries.text: It helps me if instructions are written down.
entries.easy_read:
Written words help me.
Please write my work steps.
hints: Say it calmly, as a fact

entries.text: A quieter place to work would help me concentrate.
entries.easy_read:
Noise makes my work hard.
A quiet place helps me.

entries.text: I work carefully, so I may need a little extra time.
entries.easy_read:
I do good work.
I need more time to do it.

entries.text: Could I do this task sitting down?
entries.easy_read:
Standing is hard for me.
Can I sit and work?

entries.text: Short regular breaks help me keep my work steady.
entries.easy_read:
I need small rests.
Then my work stays good.

entries.text: Brighter lighting at my station would help me see clearly.
entries.easy_read:
It is dark here.
More light helps me see.

entries.text: Could we have captions on for the training video?
entries.easy_read:
I cannot hear the video.
Please turn on the words.

entries.text: I will need a sign language interpreter for the meeting.
entries.easy_read:
I use sign language.
Please book a helper for the meeting.

entries.text: Thank you for arranging that. It makes a real difference.
entries.easy_read:
You helped me.
It helps my work a lot.
I say thank you.

entries.text: I am back from leave. Is there anything I should catch up on?
entries.easy_read:
I was away.
Now I am back.
I ask what I missed.

entries.text: Where do I submit my leave form?
entries.easy_read:
I filled the leave paper.
I ask where to give it.

entries.text: Could we review my adjustments after a month to see if they work?
entries.easy_read:
We changed some things for me.
Let us talk again in one month.
We can see if it helps.
